hypothesis: A planner whose complete interface is the bare intent grow or finish will produce more valid planner decisions and better outcomes than the instruction-shaped legacy planner while leaving action, target, tactic, and timing to the mature executor.

promotion_gate.required_outcome: candidate wins more fields than the live parent
promotion_gate.required_planner_evidence: at least one accepted non-bootstrap pln decision and no invalid third intent
promotion_gate.tie_policy: Do not promote a performance candidate on a tie.
promotion_gate.loss_policy: Do not promote on fewer wins than the live parent.

authorized_next_action: Build and inspect the local candidate image. A separate explicit execution step is required before any hosted upload or counterfactual.
